prompt:
== the run, in beats ==
T 0 — 10 events, 5 beats
  1 | do +dismissed_briefing +quiet_response +conversational_opening   [env]
    | do +busy_yes                                                     [env]
    | do +appointment_passed +no_departure_observed                    [env]
    | do +cancellation_report +design_work_report +evening_review      [env]
  2 | consider_explanations  — [B01-C04-S01] "There were other explanations."  ⇒ gone: dismissed_briefing, interpretation_open, quiet_response; new: ambiguous_observations, hypothesis_upset, hypothesis_work
  3 | ask_busy  — [B01-C04-S01] "Busy morning?"  ⇒ gone: conversational_opening; new: busy_question; stays: ambiguous_observations
    | apparent_missed_appointment  — [B01-C04-S02] "This appeared to support her hypothesis"  ⇒ gone: appointment_passed, no_departure_observed; new: apparent_miss; stays: hypothesis_upset
  4 | reduce_interruptions  — [B01-C04-S01] "I'll keep the interruptions down."  ⇒ gone: busy_question, busy_yes, research_pending; new: interruptions_reduced, research_deferred
    | correct_explanation  — [B01-C04-S02] "The cancellation had arrived through a channel she could not read."  ⇒ gone: apparent_miss, cancellation_report, design_work_report, hypothesis_upset, hypothesis_work; new: evidence_gap_acknowledged, working_explanation
  5 | retain_ambiguity_case  — [B01-C04-S03] "The original events had not changed."  ⇒ gone: evening_review; new: ambiguity_case_saved; stays: ambiguous_observations, working_explanation
== interventions (NOT chance) ==
[env] do +dismissed_briefing +quiet_response +conversational_opening
[env] do +busy_yes
[env] do +appointment_passed +no_departure_observed
[env] do +cancellation_report +design_work_report +evening_review
These beats were decided OUTSIDE the story's chances. [forced]: the
player chose it — tell it as the choice that was made, never as luck,
fate or the dice. [do]: an intervention, a what-if imposed on the
story — tell it as a supposition ("suppose…", "had…", "in this
telling…"). [env]: the world outside the rules moved (an arrival, a
clock, a sensor) — tell it as something that happened TO the story,
from outside, never as a character's doing. A [do +X]/[do -X] start
state was set by hand: say so.
Never present any of these as a character's spontaneous impulse
unless a rule's doc says so.

== the rules (with their approved doc comments) ==
catalog nina_book01_ch04 1.
provenance text "book-01:94e2c5829e6ebefa3bd41e35e513bba943dc8e12:C04" "2026-11-25".
layers (story).
stages (live).
namespace narrative produce (story).
pred ambiguity_case_saved : narrative.
pred ambiguous_observations : narrative.
pred apparent_miss : narrative.
pred appointment_passed : narrative.
pred busy_question : narrative.
pred busy_yes : narrative.
pred cancellation_report : narrative.
pred conversational_opening : narrative.
pred design_work_report : narrative.
pred dismissed_briefing : narrative.
pred evening_review : narrative.
pred evidence_gap_acknowledged : narrative.
pred hypothesis_upset : narrative.
pred hypothesis_work : narrative.
pred interpretation_open : narrative.
pred interruptions_reduced : narrative.
pred monitoring_active : narrative.
pred no_departure_observed : narrative.
pred quiet_response : narrative.
pred research_deferred : narrative.
pred research_pending : narrative.
pred working_explanation : narrative.
stage live {
  %% [B01-C04-S01] "There were other explanations."
  consider_explanations [story] : interpretation_open * dismissed_briefing * quiet_response -o hypothesis_upset * hypothesis_work * ambiguous_observations.
  %% [B01-C04-S01] "Busy morning?"
  ask_busy [story] : $ambiguous_observations * conversational_opening -o busy_question.
  %% [B01-C04-S01] "I'll keep the interruptions down."
  reduce_interruptions [story] : busy_question * busy_yes * research_pending -o research_deferred * interruptions_reduced.
  %% [B01-C04-S02] "This appeared to support her hypothesis"
  apparent_missed_appointment [story] : appointment_passed * no_departure_observed * $hypothesis_upset -o apparent_miss.
  %% [B01-C04-S02] "The cancellation had arrived through a channel she could not read."
  correct_explanation [story] : apparent_miss * hypothesis_upset * hypothesis_work * cancellation_report * design_work_report -o working_explanation * evidence_gap_acknowledged.
  %% [B01-C04-S03] "The original events had not changed."
  retain_ambiguity_case [story] : $ambiguous_observations * $working_explanation * evening_review -o ambiguity_case_saved.
}

Now narrate this run, in at most 290 words.
